n.story:
Your role is transitioning from a manual laborer to a high-precision production technician. In the coming years, the tedious aspects of your job—calculating the most efficient way to cut a sheet of plywood or identifying wood species and defects—will be handled instantly by AI-powered computer vision and nesting algorithms. Instead of spending your morning sketching out cutting plans and manually adjusting fence settings for every board, you will oversee a suite of smart tools that suggest the optimal workflow to minimize waste and maximize output.

While the physical act of guiding a bespoke piece of timber through a blade remains a human craft, your value will increasingly lie in your ability to troubleshoot complex machine errors and maintain quality standards that sensors might miss. You will spend less time moving heavy stock and more time using augmented reality overlays to visualize how a finished product will look before the first cut is even made. You are becoming the 'pilot' of the workshop, using data to ensure every cut is perfect and every scrap of material is accounted for.

n.story:
Your role is shifting from a manual machine tender to a high-level process overseer. In the past, much of your day was consumed by the physical demands of feeding glass fibers, monitoring analog gauges, and manually adjusting temperatures. As AI-driven digital twins and IoT sensors take over these repetitive monitoring tasks, the 'black box' of the pultrusion process becomes transparent. You will no longer spend your hours reacting to deviations; instead, the system will predict them before they occur.

This transition frees you to focus on the complex chemistry and engineering of the materials. You will use AI to simulate how different fiber reinforcements and resin types will behave under specific conditions, allowing you to optimize production parameters for strength and cost-efficiency in ways that were previously impossible. Your value will lie in your ability to troubleshoot novel mechanical failures that baffle the algorithm and to ensure that the final product meets rigorous quality standards that require human verification.

tools: AI-powered computer vision for defect detection
Generative AI for technical manual querying
n.adv: Focus on learning the basics of data interpretation and how to interact with digital twin interfaces. Your future value is in understanding the 'why' behind the process parameters rather than the 'how' of manual operation.
